# Eshwar Home Products

Eshwar Home Products is a neighbourhood food and pantry store in Perambur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.

## Store identity
- English name: Eshwar Home Products
- Tamil name: ஈஸ்வர் ஹோம் புராடக்ட்ஸ்
- Website: https://startupintelligence.github.io/eshwar-home-products/
- Address: Door No. 119/1, Nelvayal Road, Neelam Garden, Bunder Garden, Perambur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600011, India
- Phone: +91 99412 09953
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919941209953
- Area served: Perambur, Chennai

## Official channels
- Official YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@EHP_PeramburOfficial

## Opening hours
- Monday to Saturday: 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM
- Sunday: 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM

## Store offerings
The store catalogue describes these categories and selections:
- Traditional rice varieties and millet varieties (Siruthaniyam)
- Millet flours, millet cookies, flakes, vermicelli and pasta
- Cold-pressed oils: gingelly, groundnut and coconut
- Ghee and dairy
- Honey, pulses, dry fruits and nuts
- Health mix (Sathumaavu)
- Mudavattukal Kilangu

The catalogue is a guide to product categories, not a live stock guarantee. Specific varieties, pack sizes, prices and availability may change. Customers should contact the store to confirm current details before visiting.
